svg.text: Image-input geometry: two execution targets, one invariant
canonical views rendered by the project's own geometry module from DENTEX image 624; the target choice is deliberately open
static slots: 5 FULL + 10 CROP + 4 COMPARE = 19 slots = 7,488 vision tokens - one XLA graph, no recompilation
runs so far: original images, dynamic shapes
GPU runs so far feed native images with dynamic padding; a --canonical-resize flag
exists for the same views - the final choice is pending the first GPU run
OPEN DECISION - execution target: GPU (RTX 4090 / RTX Pro 6000 / A100) vs TPU v5e-8; to be settled by the first GPU run
shared invariant: tools always execute on the native image · evaluation runs at original size · SFT, GRPO and evaluation use the same setting
TPU padding changes no gradients: the padded tail carries labels = -100 and attention_mask = 0 (verified against the reference implementation)
